messages:
From: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@brightline.com>

Subject: Portal access issue during PO upload

Hi Hannah,

We're trying to upload PO-12345 into the supplier portal but keep getting kicked back to the login screen mid-upload. The UI says 'session expired' but our session cookie shows it's active for 60 minutes. Happens in Chrome and Edge; cleared cache and tried again. Attached a screenshot of the error and the PO PDF.

This is blocking our finance team — can you advise? We need the PO processed by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,

Hi Oliver — thanks for the report and attaching the screenshot, that helps.

Quick asks while we triage:
- Can you confirm whether you were signed in via SSO (Workday) or via email link?
- If you have a moment, please try an incognito window (no extensions) and re-upload.

I'll loop in Ben and Tessa to prioritize. If this looks like a session-token split (we've seen a cookie domain change on some IdP handoffs), we can generate a one-time upload link so you can finish the PO immediately.

2) If still failing, I'll send a temporary upload link (valid 4 hours) and open SUP-9124 for engineering.

Subject: Re: Portal access issue during PO upload

Hannah — I dug into SUP-9124 and reproduced a similar flow: when Workday SSO returns a relay-state containing an extra query param (tenant_hint), our session cookie domain is re-evaluated and a new session is created for a different subdomain. Result: the upload POST hits a different session and gets a 401 -> UI shows 'session expired'.

Temporary mitigation for Oliver: I've created a one-time upload link that bypasses the SSO redirect and POSTs directly to the upload endpoint. Link (valid 4 hours): https://portal.redwood.ai/tmp-upload/4a7f2b9c
- Please use incognito if possible.
- I also attached a short debug header (we'll collect more if it fails).

I've added engineering notes to SUP-9124 and flagged for a patch to normalize cookie domain selection on the IdP callback. Tessa — can you include this in the next morning deploy candidate? It's a high-severity onboarding blocker for Brightline (related_account: Brightline Logistics).

Ben Carter
Sr. Technical Program Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
